disposition_reason: A risk-assessment commentary that computes margins of exposure from other authors' published lead and cadmium data in unrecorded fruit spirits; it reports no new measurements.

study.design: Margin-of-exposure risk assessment using literature occurrence data
study.origin: Unrecorded (home-produced) fruit spirits, Slovak Republic and Hungary, per cited studies
study.method: MOE = BMDL or NOAEL / estimated intake; no laboratory analysis

regulatory_or_exposure.value: Ethanol BMDL10 700 mg/kg bw/day; lead BMDL01 0.0015 mg/kg bw/day; cadmium NOAEL 0.01 mg/kg bw/day

regulatory_or_exposure.what: MOE, lead in unrecorded fruit spirits (from Tatarková et al. data)
MOE, cadmium in unrecorded plum spirits (from Tatarková et al. data)

unresolved: Occurrence data come from Tatarková et al. 2019 (lead, n=18; cadmium, n=35) and Pflaum et al.; the concentrations themselves are not printed here and were not back-calculated from MOEs.
Primary studies by Tatarková et al. would be needed for occurrence values.
